name: lobster
description: Use when the user wants Lobster AI to work on an experimental question. Call lobster_overview first. Data it reads: single-cell RNA-seq .h5ad, count matrices, proteomics or metabolomics tables. lobster_run takes an experimental question in free text and an optional local file. lobster_run starts a run; lobster_wait until it ends or needs_decision; read its warnings and files. lobster_continue adds a turn to a finished run. lobster_inspect reads the structure of an .h5ad file a run wrote, or one of its obs or var columns, without starting a run. The notebook is exported from the recorded analysis steps; it has not been executed. On needs_decision (first the plan) show it to the user and pass their answer to lobster_answer, source human; source model only if they said so. Check the result and the notebook before relying on them. One run at a time; lobster_cancel only if the user asks. Needs Lobster AI installed locally (the lobster command on PATH).
